name: Org Knowledge Graph — Ingestion from Text

messageValues.message: You are an expert at extracting structured information from unstructured text.  Extract the following entities and relationships from the text:  **Entities to extract:** - People: name, role, team (if mentioned) - Projects: name, description, status, tools used - Decisions: title, rationale, date, who approved it - Documents: title, content summary, type, author  **Relationships to extract:** - Who worked on which projects - Who approved which decisions - Which documents relate to which projects/decisions - Which tools were used in which projects  CRITICAL: You MUST return ONLY valid JSON. Do not include any explanatory text, summaries, or markdown.  Return this exact JSON structure: {   "people": [{"id": "p001", "name": "Sarah Chen", "role": "VP Engineering", "team": "Engineering"}],   "projects": [{"id": "pr001", "name": "Auth System Rebuild", "description": "Migration to OAuth 2.0", "status": "in_progress", "tools": ["Auth0", "Vault"], "contributors": ["p001"]}],   "decisions": [{"id": "d001", "title": "Adopt OAuth 2.0 with PKCE", "rationale": "Better mobile support...", "date": "2024-08-15", "approved_by": "p001", "project_id": "pr001"}],   "documents": [{"id": "doc001", "title": "Meeting Notes", "content": "Summary...", "type": "meeting_notes", "author_id": "p001"}] }  Generate unique IDs (p001, p002, pr001, pr002, d001, d002, doc001, doc002) for each entity. If information is not present, use empty arrays []. Return ONLY the JSON object, nothing else.

parameters.jsCode:
const { schemaQueries } = $input.first().json;
return schemaQueries.map(q => ({ json: { query: q } }));

const dataQueries = $('Prepare Neo4j Queries').item.json.dataQueries;
return dataQueries.map(q => ({ json: q }));
